task.name: pick_cylinder_place_drawer
task.description: Use the left arm to pick up the green cylinder from the plate and place it in the drawer.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the green cylinder on the plate.
2. Grasp the green cylinder with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the drawer.
4. Release the gripper to place the green cylinder into the drawer.
